visual_elements.description: Scaled Dot-Product Attention (left): vertical pipeline inside a green (#00B050) rectangle border. Bottom row of three circles: Q (red, white letter), K (blue), V (blue). Above them, bottom-to-top stack of small rounded boxes joined by thin black up-arrows: 'MatMul' (lavender), 'Scale' (pale yellow), 'Mask (opt.)' (pale pink), 'SoftMax' (pale green), 'MatMul' (lavender, top). A vertical bypass line runs along the left inner edge from the frame bottom up into the top 'MatMul' [?]. A short arrow exits the top 'MatMul' upward. Tiny green square handles appear at the border corners (likely selection handles in the source screenshot).

Multi-Head Attention (center): vertical pipeline inside a green (#00B050) rectangle border. Bottom row: circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red); each feeds up into its own white 'Linear' box (three in a row, each with gray offset copies behind suggesting stacked layers). All three converge into one wide pink box 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' (two text lines) that also has gray offset copies behind it (h parallel heads). A small tan circle labeled 'h' sits to the right of the stack with a short pointer arrow. Above: yellow 'Concat' box, then a white 'Linear' box, with a black arrow exiting the top. All connectors are thin black up-arrows.

Encoder–Decoder architecture (right): two abutting panels — Encoder panel (light peach fill, italic red label 'Encoder' at its top-left) and Decoder panel (light green fill, italic green label 'Decoder' at its top-right). Encoder column bottom→top: text 'Inputs'; thick red block up-arrow; box 'Input Embedding' (tan); small tan circle icon (clock/sine glyph) with two-line label 'Positional Encoding' at its left; box 'Add & Norm' (cream); box 'Multi-Head Attention' under translucent orange highlight, with circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) just beneath it; box 'Add & Norm'; box 'Feed Forward' (olive, two lines); box 'Add & Norm' (top). Decoder column bottom→top: text 'Outputs (shifted right)' with 'Outputs' yellow-highlighted; box 'Output Embedding' (maroon); tan circle icon with two-line label 'Positional Encoding' at its right; box 'Add & Norm'; purple box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) at its base; box 'Add & Norm'; box 'Multi-Head Attention' [?] under translucent orange highlight (cross-attention, text partly obscured); box 'Add & Norm'; box 'Feed Forward' (olive); box 'Add & Norm'; green box 'Linear'; green box 'Softmax'; small text 'Probabilities'; thick red block up-arrow to bold label 'Output' at top. Gray 'N×' sits just outside the decoder's right edge at attention-block height. Thin dark connectors join all boxes vertically.

Instructor annotation overlays on the architecture: (a) translucent yellow rectangle spanning both panels' upper 'Feed Forward / Add & Norm' zone; (b) translucent orange rectangle over the encoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' box, extending left to/past the encoder panel edge; (c) translucent orange rectangle over the decoder's attention area, extending right past the decoder panel edge; box text under (b) and (c) is partially obscured.
